title: 第1375章 攻打神柱第1374章 红瑶圣宫
content_zh:
“林公子！”
洪河星行这边，郑老也在，他立刻腾空而起，将林炎保护了起来，免得一些敌对势力趁机下黑手。
“郑老，快劝阻岳父大人他们！不能继续破坏下去了，否则的话将会给洪河星域造成不可挽回的毁灭后果！”
林炎声音洪亮，不只是郑老听得见，就连其他势力的高层也都听得清清楚楚。
“小子，你在说什么？”
几大势力的人皆是神色不善。红瑶圣宫一旦开启，几大势力皆是可以借机一飞冲天，而林炎却说会造成不可挽回的损失？开什么玩笑！
就连郑老也都十分疑惑：“姑爷，你最好解释清楚，否则的话即便是老夫也不好说上话啊！”
此地可是牵扯到了洪河星域前十的势力。即便他们洪河星行，也不是说停就能停的。
“来不及解释了，让他们先停手！否则洪河星域就真的完了！不行你就想办法送我去我岳父那！我来劝他们！”
林炎急促道。
这时，上官月也跟了过来：“对，郑老，你送我们过去！”
“这！”
郑老略微迟疑，可是看到林炎和上官月严肃的表情之后，便立刻带着两人，朝着战斗中心区域而去。
此刻，那几位至强者正在全力轰击神柱，不过到了他们这个境界，感知何等敏锐，自然是察觉到了郑老三人的气息。
“有两只蝼蚁过来了！”
焚天宗的宗主冷哼一声。
“不管他们，继续轰击神柱，神柱快坚持不住了！”
圣殿的副殿主低喝。
于是几大巨头便加大了轰击。
“不能再打下去了，这根神柱一旦坍塌，洪河星域都会被毁掉！”

林炎神色陡变，而后厉声道。
“哪里来的小辈？居然敢在我们几大巨头跟前放肆！”
圣殿的大长老武天罡眼中寒光一闪，猛地一巴掌拍向林炎，要趁机捏死林炎。
“武天罡，你过分了！居然当着本尊的面动本尊的女婿。”
上官尊皇闷哼一声，出手挡住了武天罡，将林炎庇护了下来。
“此人就是上官尊皇的女婿？”
这下几位大佬都不由投来了诧异的眼神。
最近这段时间，林炎之名可谓是闹得沸沸扬扬！在始祖山大放异彩，让圣殿吃瘪！慑服圣殿太长老！拜入洪河星行，成为无上巨头上官尊皇的女婿！每一件都是石破天惊！哪怕只是个小辈，却也已经让在场的这些巨头们都记忆深刻了！
“这就是救了红剑的小家伙么？之前金剑也对他赞不绝口！”
古阳剑尊轻语。早在林炎扬名之前，他就通过剑神殿的一些人知道了林炎之名，也知道眼前这个年轻人，跟他们剑神殿有着一些因果。
暗影神殿的大长老则是面色不善，他们暗影神殿跟林炎，亦有恩怨！
“哼，上官尊皇，就算此子是你的女婿，可是也不能阻止我等共谋大事。若是耽误了，你洪河星行承担得起吗？”
圣殿的副殿主冷笑道，直接给上官尊皇扣了一顶帽子。
果然，其他的几位无上巨头都眼神冷冽地望向上官尊皇，林炎突然阻止，这件事必须要给一个交代！这关乎到他们这些巨头的威严。
content_en:
"Master Lin!"
On Honghe Xingxing's side, Mr. Zheng was also there. He immediately rose into the air and protected Lin Yan to prevent some hostile forces from taking the opportunity to do evil.
"Mr. Zheng, please stop my father-in-law and the others! We can't continue to destroy it, otherwise it will cause irreparable destruction to the Honghe Star Territory!"
Lin Yan's voice was loud and clear. Not only Mr. Zheng could hear it, but also the senior officials of other forces could hear it clearly.
"Boy, what are you talking about?"
The people from several major forces all looked bad. Once the Hongyao Holy Palace is opened, several major forces can take the opportunity to soar into the sky, but Lin Yan said that it will cause irreparable losses? What a joke!
Even Mr. Zheng was very confused: "Uncle, you'd better explain clearly, otherwise even I will have trouble talking!"
This place involves the top ten forces in the Honghe Star Region. Even if they travel like a river, they can't just stop.
"It's too late to explain, let them stop first! Otherwise, the Honghe Star Territory will really be over! If not, just find a way to send me to my father-in-law! I'll persuade them!"
Lin Yan said hurriedly.
At this time, Shangguan Yue also followed: "Yes, Mr. Zheng, send us there!"
"This!"
Mr. Zheng hesitated slightly, but after seeing the serious expressions of Lin Yan and Shangguan Yue, he immediately led them towards the center of the battle.
At this moment, the most powerful ones were bombarding the divine pillar with all their strength, but at their level, with such keen perception, they naturally sensed the auras of Mr. Zheng and the others.
"Two ants are coming!"
The leader of Burning Heaven Sect snorted coldly.
"Ignore them and continue bombarding the divine pillar. The divine pillar can no longer hold on!"
The deputy master of the temple shouted.
So several giants stepped up their bombardment.
"We can't fight any longer. Once this divine pillar collapses, the Honghe Star Region will be destroyed!"
Lin Yan's expression suddenly changed, and then he said sternly.
"Where did this junior come from? How dare you act so arrogantly in front of our giants!"
Wu Tiangang, the great elder of the temple, had a cold gleam in his eyes, and slapped Lin Yan with a sudden slap, intending to take the opportunity to crush Lin Yan to death.
"Wu Tiangang, you have gone too far! You actually touched my son-in-law in front of me."
Shangguan Zunhuang snorted and took action to block Wu Tiangang and protect Lin Yan.
"Is this person the son-in-law of Shangguan Zunhuang?"
At this time, several big guys couldn't help but cast surprised looks.
Recently, Lin Yan's name has been making a lot of noise! Show off your glory in the Ancestral Mountain and let the temple collapse! Conquer the temple elder! Join Honghe Xingxing and become the son-in-law of the supreme giant Shangguan Zunhuang! Every piece is earth-shattering! Even though he is just a junior, he has already left a deep impression on the giants present!
"Is this the little guy who saved Hong Jian? Jin Jian was also full of praise for him before!"
Sword Lord Guyang whispered. Long before Lin Yan became famous, he knew Lin Yan's name through some people in the Sword Temple, and also knew that the young man in front of him had some karma with their Sword Temple.
The great elder of the Shadow Temple looked unkind. They, the Shadow Temple, also had a grudge against Lin Yan!
"Hmph, Shangguan Zunhuang, even if this son is your son-in-law, it can't stop us from collaborating on big things. If it is delayed, can you, Honghe Xingxing, afford it?"
The deputy temple master of the temple sneered and slapped Shangguan Zunhuang directly.
Sure enough, the other supreme giants all looked at Shangguan Zunhuang with cold eyes. Lin Yan suddenly stopped him. This matter must be explained! This is related to the majesty of these giants.
